title: Late Fusion with Triplet Margin Objective for Multimodal Ideology Prediction and Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal transformer architectures (using early and late fusion) on their ability to predict the political ideology or media slant (e.g., a 5-point scale from Left to Right) of news articles, Reddit posts, and tweets based on paired text and image inputs.

Qualitative error analysis and human-annotator comparison of the DeepFace facial recognition tool used for dataset annotation, specifically noting its tendency to misclassify the race of prominent political figures based on stereotyped physical features.
